description: This Java interface defines the common response structure for connectivity commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for retrieving the connection identifier, resource path, and resource type, as well as a nested class defining JSON field constants related to connectivity command responses.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface for responses related to connectivity commands, providing methods to retrieve connection details and define JSON structure.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines JSON field constants specific to ConnectivityCommandResponse, including 'connectionId'.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection as a deprecated string, delegating to getConnectionEntityId().

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the connection entity's ConnectionId object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Overrides CommandResponse to return the connection entity ID.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer for resource path, defaulting to an empty pointer.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for connectivity commands.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets DittoHeaders on the response; returns an instance of T.
